info.title: samgovapi.io API
info.description: SAM.gov entities, contract opportunities, exclusions, USAspending awards, NAICS, PSC and GSA labor rates as JSON. Every answer carries meta.source, meta.as_of and meta.credits_charged. Free plan: 100 credits a month, 20 requests a minute. Independent; not affiliated with GSA, SAM.gov or any U.S. government agency.

get.summary: List Alerts
get.description: A saved watch on SAM.gov data, such as a registration expiry for a UEI or new opportunities matching your NAICS and PSC codes.

get.summary: Read a Alert
Onboarding questions
get.description: The questions that finish setting up an account. No key needed; with a key the reply also carries the current answers. Costs no quota.

post.description: Stores the answers exactly as the onboarding form does, marked as answered by an agent. Idempotent. Costs no quota.

data_wanted.description: What SAM.gov or federal contracting data are you looking for?

use_case.description: What do you want to do with it?

client.description: Your name, such as Claude Code.

get.summary: Subscription status and cancel reasons
get.description: The account's subscription and the reasons a cancellation accepts. Costs no quota.

post.summary: Cancel the subscription at the end of the paid period
post.description: Only when your user asks. A reason is required: ask your user why and never pick one for them. Costs no quota.

reason.description: got_what_i_needed: I got the data I needed; too_expensive: Too expensive; missing_data: Missing data or features I need; reliability: Errors or slow responses; not_using: Not using it enough; switched: Switched to another service; other: Something else

comment.description: Your user's own words. Required when reason is other.

200.description: Scheduled to cancel at period end

400.description: CANCEL_REASON_REQUIRED: the reply lists the valid reasons

delete.summary: Keep the subscription (undo a scheduled cancel)
